title: prepare-dist config
description: Settings for the prepare-dist script, read from .prepare-distrc.json in the repository root.

clean.description: Whether the existing dist is left out of the new one. Set it to false to keep the files that are already in dist, such as build output.

removedFields.description: Fields of package.json that are left out of the published manifest. The list replaces the default.

include.description: Files and directories, relative to the repository root, that are copied into dist. The list replaces the default.
